# Kanwar Arcade

> Free browser games by Kanwar Afaq. 13 games, no downloads, no accounts, no ads. Scores are saved only in the player's own browser.

## Games
- [Starfall](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/starfall.html): Starfall is a free space shooter you can play in your browser. Dodge, shoot, grab power-ups and beat the boss.
- [Brick Rally](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/brick-rally.html): Brick Rally is a free brick-breaker you can play in your browser. Five levels, power-ups and a streak multiplier.
- [Serpentine](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/serpentine.html): Serpentine is a free snake game for your browser with smooth glowing graphics, combo fruit and rocks to dodge. Play with arrow keys or swipe.
- [Skyhop](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/skyhop.html): Skyhop is a free one-tap flying game for your browser. Flap through gaps, collect stars and fly from sunrise into the night.
- [Lightmerge](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/lightmerge.html): Lightmerge is a free 2048-style sliding puzzle for your browser. Merge matching tiles, chase combos and reach 2048. Play with arrow keys or swipe.
- [Driftrock](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/driftrock.html): Driftrock is a free neon asteroid shooter for your browser. Fly, shoot and survive waves of splitting rocks. Play with the keyboard, mouse or touch.
- [Lumenfall](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/lumenfall.html): Lumenfall is a free 3D adventure that runs in your browser. Explore Crystal Valley, fight enemies, find nine energy crystals and reach the final portal.
- [Neon Velocity](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/neon-velocity.html): Neon Velocity is a free 3D arcade racer for your browser. Pick a car, race three rivals over three laps, drift corners and burn your nitro.
- [Starfall Protocol](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/starfall-protocol.html): Starfall Protocol is a free 3D top-down shooter for your browser. Restore the relay, clear the hostiles and take down the Reactor Sentinel.
- [Aether Run](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/aether-run.html): Aether Run is a neon hover-racing browser game with a procedural skyline, glowing light trails, collectable energy rings, and atmospheric sound effects.
- [Moonlit Grove](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/moonlit-grove.html): Moonlit Grove is a free fantasy survival browser game. Cast spells, dash past shadows and defend an enchanted sanctuary through rising waves.
- [Park Dash](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/park-dash.html): Park Dash is an animated kids running racing game with four rival runners, lanes, jumps, stars, sprinting and a 1500-meter finish line. No cars or scooters.
- [Serpent Studio](https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/serpent-studio.html): Serpent Studio offers Classic, Zen, 90-second Sprint and Maze modes, three speed settings, four skins, glowing graphics and separate mode high scores.
